products.title: Moms' Winter Retreat: Cozy Cabin, Yoga, Journal & Fireside Connection in Ancient Redwood Forest
products.description_html:
Saturday, Jan. 23 — Sunday, Jan. 24, 2027

Rediscover Your Wild Heart. Connect with Ancient Forest, Fellow Moms and Your Deepest Self

Imagine wandering through a cathedral of ancient redwoods draped in emerald moss, then journaling by a crackling fire with women who understand the beautiful exhaustion of motherhood — and sleeping to the sound of (wait for it) QUIET in a cozy cabin.

January is when the Santa Cruz Mountains come alive. Winter rains turn everything impossibly green: mushrooms push up through the forest floor, banana slugs glide across the trail, and old-growth redwoods up to 12 feet across drip with moss. It's nature's season of deep rest before spring — a reminder that dormancy isn't emptiness; it's gathering strength. Just like you.

All you need to bring is your sleeping bag and an open heart. We'll handle the rest.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

🌲 Ancient Redwoods in Winter

A 2-mile hike in through some of the region's biggest old-growth redwoods, plus a nature scavenger hunt for the forest's winter treasures: unique mushrooms, brilliant slugs and delicate moss.

🏡 A Cozy Cabin, Not a Tent

Baseboard heat, a wood-burning stove, a full kitchen, real beds with mattress pads, running water and actual restrooms. Get deliciously muddy on the trail, then come back to warmth.

🔥 Fireside Connection

Storytelling, board games, real laughter and s'mores by the stove. This is where masks drop and friendships start.

🧘‍♀️ Yoga, Art & Journaling

Sunday-morning yoga with Miranda (25 years of practice, all levels welcome), a journal to keep, art supplies, and time to simply sit and listen to the forest.

🍽️ Meals Without the Work

A simple vegetarian dinner Saturday and breakfast Sunday, made for you. S'mores kit included, because what's a cabin retreat without melted chocolate?

🫶🏽 Your Mom Squad Is Waiting

Come depleted, come energized, come exactly as you are. Solo travelers especially welcome — instant friendships guaranteed.

Ready to trade your to-do list for moss-covered giants and crackling fires? This is your invitation to remember who you are beneath all the roles you play.

images.alt: Moms' cabin retreat in the Santa Cruz Mountains: a mom roasting a marshmallow by the wood stove, a banana slug, a giant redwood and moms cheering on a ridge

products.title: MLK Day Redwoods, Banana Slugs & Ocean Rocks
products.description_html:
A 1,700-year-old redwood, banana slugs by the dozen and ancient ocean rocks on an easy MLK Day hike, then lunch at Alice’s Restaurant.

Monday, January 18, 2027, 10:30 a.m. — 1:00 p.m. • Peninsula

Kids home for MLK Day? Join us for a magical winter forest adventure! We'll visit a 1,700-year-old Redwood giant where bears once scratched their backs, explore mystical fog drifting through bright green moss-covered trees, and count banana slugs by the dozens (we found 50+ last time!). After our hike, we'll refuel at the legendary Alice's Restaurant — a Bay Area icon and perfect way to complete our holiday outing.

🥳 PART OF OUR WINTER WONDERS BUNDLE (for DROP-IN only, see info below) 🥳

Your whole winter season, planned for you and your family — with our signature outings! ❄️

We have so much FUN on these adventures — they sell out every year — so this season we're capping numbers and prioritizing families who choose the bundle option first. Grab all 3 day adventures in one go, and your family saves $30 compared to booking each one separately at today's rates.

While you can still do drop-ins per day trip, bundle families get priority booking and guaranteed spots across all 3 dates. Drop-in spots will be limited.

🌰 10/25 — Chestnut Collecting, Chestnut Honey Tasting, Golden Fall Leaves, Lake Hike + Optional Pizza Dinner (La Honda Area)

💦 12/13 — Winter Waterfall Wonderland, Ladybug Love, Leopard-Spotted Banana Slugs + Fungi Hunt (South Bay)

🐌 1/18 — MLK Day: Banana Slug Bonanza, 1,700-Year-Old Redwood + Ancient Ocean Rocks (Peninsula)

SIGN UP FOR THE BUNDLE HERE: Winter Wonders bundle

FOR MLK DAY, HERE'S WHAT TO EXPECT:

🐌🍄 BANANA SLUG BONANZA + WINTER WONDERS! On our last visit, we counted 50+ banana slugs! Plus, discover colorful fungi decorating the trees, vibrant green moss carpeting everything, and misty fog creating that magical winter forest vibe.

🌲🌳 ANCIENT REDWOOD GIANT: We'll visit a 1,700-year-old original-growth Redwood! While most trees were logged in the late 1800s, a few incredible giants remain. Kids can marvel at these towering survivors while parents appreciate the history beneath the canopy.

🪨🌊 TAFONI TREASURES — ANCIENT OCEAN ROCKS! Explore giant sandstone boulders formed when this area was underwater! These unique Tafoni formations are a geological wonder that will spark kids' curiosity and imagination.

🎨🔍 Educational Fun for Families: Nature scavenger hunt with checklist to keep! Plus arts-and-craft activities for the kids with a special treat to take home. Perfect for engaging little learners!

🍔🥧 ICONIC ALICE'S RESTAURANT: After our hike, we'll head to this legendary Bay Area landmark for lunch! A must-visit spot with great food and classic atmosphere.

🚼🛴 SUPER FAMILY-FRIENDLY: Just 2.6 miles with gradual decline, then uphill. Suitable for jogging strollers, wagons and bikes! Perfect for families with little ones.

🏕️❤️ Community, Friendship + Support: Instant playdate for your kiddos! Kids from toddlers to tweens all play together. Reconnect with MMH friends and make new ones! Solo parenting? Forgot snacks? Need wipes? We've got your back!

📖🗺️ Explore the Peninsula! We'll include tips on what to see in this area to make it a full day trip adventure if you'd like!

Difficulty: Easy. 2.6 miles with gradual decline then uphill. Suitable for jogging strollers, wagons and bikes. Great for all ages!

We look forward to welcoming you + your family on the trail!

products.title: Winter Waterfalls, Ladybugs & Banana Slugs
products.description_html:
Rushing winter waterfalls, a fungi hunt, leopard-spotted banana slugs and the Ladybug Christmas Tree, on an easy, stroller-friendly trail.

Sunday, Dec. 13, 2026, 10:30 a.m. — 12:45 p.m. • South Bay

Join us for a winter wonderland adventure where we'll explore rushing waterfalls, hunt for colorful mushrooms and leopard-spotted banana slugs, and search for clusters of ladybugs — we call this spot the Ladybug Christmas Tree! 🎄🐞

🥳 PART OF OUR WINTER WONDERS BUNDLE (for DROP-IN only, see info below) 🥳

Your whole winter season, planned for you and your family — with our signature outings! ❄️

We have so much FUN on these adventures — they sell out every year — so this season we're capping numbers and prioritizing families who choose the bundle option first. Grab all 3 day adventures in one go, and your family saves $30 compared to booking each one separately at today's rates.

While you can still do drop-ins per day trip, bundle families get priority booking and guaranteed spots across all 3 dates. Drop-in spots will be limited.

🌰 10/25 — Chestnut Collecting, Chestnut Honey Tasting, Golden Fall Leaves, Lake Hike + Optional Pizza Dinner (La Honda Area)

💦 12/13 — Winter Waterfall Wonderland, Ladybug Love, Leopard-Spotted Banana Slugs + Fungi Hunt (South Bay)

🐌 1/18 — MLK Day: Banana Slug Bonanza, 1,700-Year-Old Redwood + Ancient Ocean Rocks (Peninsula)

SIGN UP FOR THE BUNDLE HERE: Winter Wonders bundle

FOR THE WINTER WATERFALL, HERE'S WHAT TO EXPECT:

Winter waterfalls in full force 💦: This is a seriously special hike since there are so many gorgeous waterfalls! Beautiful backdrops for family photos and so fun to splash in (if you dare brave the cold!).

Fungi hunt 🍄: Try to find the turkey tail fungi growing along the logs! Winter is actually one of the best times for fungi spotting, and with all the rain we've had, they're popping up everywhere. There are quite a few other varieties as well, and we can have some fun learning the names of all of them!

Leopard spotted banana slugs 🟢: Perhaps you've seen a yellow banana slug, but have you seen a leopard-spotted GREEN banana slug?! The color of the slugs can vary depending on their diet and the amount of moisture in their environment, and the slugs in this area are rather strikingly different than their yellow cousins!

Ladybug Christmas Tree 🐞🎄: Can you find the ladybugs? When ladybugs gather here for the winter, they cluster on the branches like tiny red ornaments, which is why I call it the Ladybug Christmas Tree! Did you know that a group of ladybugs is called a "loveliness"? Just a heads-up: whether they show up depends on their migration, so we can't guarantee ladybugs this year, but this is an area where we've seen a lot of them in the past.

Rock climbing fun 🧗‍♀️: Got some adventurous climbers? There are some fun rock scrambling opportunities along the trail where the kiddos can test their climbing skills!

🔍 Scavenger Hunt: Your kids will embark on a fun scavenger hunt and get a non-edible treat!

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Meet Other Families: Connect with other adventurous families and enjoy the great outdoors together!

We look forward to welcoming you + your family on the trail!

images.alt: Collage in the South Bay: a mom and son at a winter waterfall, a family by a mossy cascade, turkey tail fungi, mushrooms, clustered ladybugs and a spotted banana slug.

products.title: Summit Sisters: Power Hike & Strength Training
products.description_html:
Seven miles and 1,500 feet of climbing, with strength training in a meadow on the way up. A training hike for moms who want to do something hard together.

Sunday, Nov. 15, 7:15 a.m.

SHORT. HARD. TRANSFORMATIVE.

4 Hours. 7 Miles. 1,500+ Ft elevation gain. YOU.

Sunday, Nov. 15 | 7:15 AM Sharp

Mamas — as often as we can, we lace up, show up and do something HARD together.

7 miles (not including a 1-mile walk from the parking area). 1,500+ feet of elevation gain. Resistance and strength training. And a community of women who show up for each other — every single time.

This is building real strength on a hillside, surrounded by your people and stunning nature, pushing through the voice that says stop — and choosing to keep going.

If you’re asking yourself if you can do it, I’m here to tell you that yes, you can.

TOGETHER, WE WILL DO THIS. 💪🏾🌿

THIS IS A TRAINING PROGRAM

Designed to build something over time: hill endurance, strength, mental toughness and a community of mamas who hold each other accountable. We want the SAME group of women showing up together, time after time — because that's how real community is built. You'll know each other's names, cheer each other on up the hard parts, and feel the difference that consistency makes — in your body and in your bonds.

Every time, you'll feel yourself getting stronger. The hills that took everything from you the first time? A few sessions in, you'll be having conversations on the way up.

And this program has a north star: the summit of that mountain. A 7-mile challenge we'll conquer together in late fall or early winter. Every time is a step closer. Every mile, every climb, every workout — it's all leading somewhere. And when we get there together? That's going to be something none of us will ever forget.

A note from Miranda: I am not a professional trainer or fitness instructor. What I am is a mama who loves the outdoors, knows this trail, and believes deeply in what we can accomplish together. Come ready to work hard, listen to your body, and have the time of your life.

WHAT AWAITS YOU 💥

🥾 The First Mile: THE BEAST We start with a climb. A real one. It will be hard. Your lungs will wake up fast and your legs will know they're working. But when you crest that first mile, you will feel absolutely FANTASTIC — and everything that follows will remind you why you came.

👊🏾 The Meadow: Resistance + Strength Training Right after that first mile, we arrive at a beautiful open meadow — and that's where we get to work. Resistance and strength training with your heart pumping and the open sky above you. No gym required. Just you and grit.

🌿 The Middle Miles: Your Reward After that opening climb, it’s still uphill — but a gradual one. The trail is mostly shaded and beautiful. This is where you catch your breath, find your stride, and take in views that will stop you in your tracks.

🌁 Views That Will Steal Your Breath You can see the San Francisco skyline from this trail. The Bay stretching out below you. The hills rolling in every direction. This is a reminder of how spectacular this world is — and how spectacular YOU are for being out here in it. And at our turnaround point at 3.5 miles? Incredible views that make every step worth it.

🚗 We Carpool! Heads up — the parking lot is small, so we make it work together. Carpooling is part of the experience — more time with your crew, less stress, better for everyone. We'll coordinate details when you sign up.

🍽️ Optional Post-Hike Celebratory Lunch If you've got time, we're keeping the party going! Join us for a celebratory lunch after the hike — share stories, laugh about the hard parts, and toast to what you just accomplished. You earned it, mama.

THE BIGGER PICTURE: THAT SUMMIT IS CALLING 🏔️

This program has a destination.

A mountain. 7 miles. A summit with views that go on forever. The last mile is also a beast — but by the time we get there, you will have spent months building exactly the strength and endurance you need to crush it. Every time we show up together is training for that moment.

And when we summit together? That's going to be something none of us will ever forget.

Questions? Ready to sign up? Drop a comment, DM, or hit the link below.

You asked for this. It's here. Let's GO. 💪🏾🌿

products.title: Niles Canyon Railway Holiday Train of Lights
products.description_html:
A vintage train strung with lights, running through the canyon after dark. Open-air general seating, or a first-class dome or parlor car.

Tuesday, Dec. 8, 4:15 — 6:30 p.m.


Roll into the holiday season with this beloved Bay Area holiday event: the Niles Canyon Railway Holiday Train of Lights! These tickets are EXTREMELY DIFFICULT TO BOOK, so for a third year in a row, we have CHARTERED THE ENTIRE TRAIN!

This year, we’ll welcome 10 adults and children for free under our EVERY 10th program. We will also have a roaming photographer on the train to capture your special holiday adventure into unforgettable memories!

About the outing, from the railway's website: 

Enjoy a 1.5-hour-long round trip through Niles Canyon filled with refreshments, music, and cheer aboard our antique coaches and open cars that feature holiday lights and decorations inside and out.

Our antique coaches and our open cars are decorated for the season, inside and out, and we enjoy holiday music on our 90-minute trip. We have some open cars with roofs where you can enjoy some of the best views of the canyon as our train makes the 90-minute round trip to Sunol and back.

The train leaves from Niles/Fremont Station at 37029 Mission Boulevard, Fremont.

*If you have any questions about the charter, you can contact Donna Alexander at Niles Canyon Railway: 510-996-8420 or station-agent@ncry.org

NOTE: First class cars: Red seats in photos are the Parlor Car, Blue seats in photos are for the Dome Car (upper and lower level)

INCLUDED in your ticket:

— Special treats for each child
— A fun family scavenger hunt
— Art activity to take home
— Our digital guide to make your experience seamless and magical
— Guaranteed seats
— All logistics of getting a seat handled by us!

products.title: Black Friday Monarchs, Tidepools & Beach
products.description_html:
Overwintering monarch butterflies by the thousand, then tiny tidepools full of crabs and anemones. The anti-shopping Black Friday.

Friday, Nov. 27, 2 — 4:30 p.m.

Friday, Nov. 27, 2026, 2-4:30 p.m.

You and your family are in for such a treat! We'll use this Black Friday to #OptOutside and to delight in monarch 🦋🦋🦋 butterflies wrapping up their annual migration and hunkering down for the winter. We'll do a short hike to see the monarchs, followed by beach play and some tidepooling! We'll meet in the afternoon since that's when the butterflies wake up! If you have trouble making 2 p.m. and want to join later, you can! It will be easy to find us.

🥳 Planning ahead? Our Winter Bundle: Waterfalls + Redwoods books both winter day trips in one purchase.


WHAT TO EXPECT for 11/27, BLACK FRIDAY ADVENTURE



🦋 MONARCH BUTTERFLIES: We'll visit a grove where migrating monarch butterflies have nestled up for the winter! Miranda will bring her kid-friendly telescope 🔭 so all of the littles can get a peek! We'll also scan the trees for some resident owls 🦉🦉🦉

🦀🐚 TIDEPOOLING MAGIC + BEACH PLAY: We'll scout for hermit crabs, sea urchins, sea anemones, blue mussels and as many seastars as we can count!! Families can also hang out on the beach 🏖️ while kids build sandcastles 🏰🏰🏰 and dams! 

🍕🍦 DINNER: Since we're meeting in the afternoon, we'll try to organize a simple meal for the group. We’ll order cheese pizza; participants need to sign up and pay for pizza in advance. Whoever is interested can join us for ice cream after beach play!!

🌇🌊 STUNNING VIEWS + SUNSET: We'll take in some stunning views and a wonderful sunset so definitely bring your nice camera 📸📸📸

🔍 SCAVENGER HUNT: Embark on a fun scavenger hunt around these very special tidepools + forest!!!

DIFFICULTY: About 1-mile EASY hike. There are some stairs so it's best to bring a front- or backpack carrier

WE LOOK FORWARD TO WELCOMING YOU + YOUR FAMILY ON THE TRAIL!

products.title: Pinnacles Easter Camping: Bat Caves & Condors
products.description_html:
Friday, March 26 — Sunday, March 28, 2027

🏕️ Pricing
Spots are priced per person, first-come, first-served — the earlier you grab yours, the less you pay.
$115/person*
$135/person once the first wave of spots is claimed
*$115 pricing is available while supplies last, or until Jan. 31 — whichever comes first.

23 million years ago several volcanoes erupted, flowed and slid to form what would become Pinnacles National Park — and it does not disappoint: We'll explore rare talus caves with waterfalls, lunch by a beautiful lake and check the skies for peregrine falcons, golden eagles and the California condor, a majestic bird that went extinct in the wild and is now making a strong comeback! Plus, we’ll cap off this one-of-a-kind Easter weekend with camp treats, crafts and classic campfire fun.

WHAT WE'LL ENJOY 🥳

🔦🦇 INCREDIBLE BAT CAVE EXPLORATION: Wear headlamps, hear the sounds of running waterfalls in the caves that are home to a rare bat population, see early spring wildflowers. Why do we go now? Because there is the potential to explore a second set of caves that is only open a few days a year. We won't know until the day of our hike if these special caves will be open.

🌊🐸 RELAX BY STUNNING LAKE + 'BEACH' ringed by terrific talus rocks that's home to swimming snakes 🐍 (and yes, we have seen them a few times!! And no, they didn't come on land 😆😆). The kids will have a blast pretend "fishing" from the "beach" while looking for snakes + frogs 🐸

🌋🧪 VOLCANO SCIENCE EXPERIMENT: Learn how Pinnacles was formed through a hands-on, leave-no-trace volcano experiment — a fun, simple way for kids to see the eruption that shaped these rocks millions of years ago!

🏔️🪨 ROCK IDENTIFICATION & GEOLOGY FUN! Learn about volcanic rocks, identify different stone types and discover how 23-million-year-old eruptions created these incredible formations. Hands-on earth science for kids!

🦅 CALIFORNIA CONDOR CHASING: We'll keep our eyes on the skies, using binoculars and the MMH telescope to spot these incredible creatures! Yes, we have spotted them on our trips here before and have a great spot to go see them!

🐰🍫 EASTER CAMPSITE GOODIE BAGS: Easter treats and festive crafts for the kids at camp. Goodie bags included!

🌺🐛 SPOT BUGS + SPRING FLOWERS: Such a great time of year to be in this normally dry, desert-like park! Wildflowers, bugs + lush green abounds!

🔍🗺️ Scavenger hunt with your kids and educational activities for families

🎨🖍️ Toy and arts-and-craft station for the kids when we're not out adventuring

🔥🍫 Classic camping fun: Campfire, stories, s'mores, stargazing and quality time away from screens

🚐⛺ RVs, CAMPER VANS + POP-UP TENTS WELCOME: This trip is set up to welcome all kinds of camping styles — tents, pop-up tents, camper vans and RVs are all a great fit.

🌿♻️ LEAVE NO TRACE ADVENTURE: Learn how to be responsible outdoor explorers! Kids discover how to protect nature for future adventurers while having fun outdoors. We adhere to Leave No Trace principles throughout the trip to keep Pinnacles pristine for future visitors.

🏕️❤️ COMMUNITY, FRIENDSHIP + SUPPORT: Instant 'playdate' for your kiddos! We usually have kids from toddlers up to tweens join, with all of the kids playing together! You might see old MMH friends + hopefully make some new ones, too! MMH offers all kinds of support: Need help setting up your tent? Forgot an important piece of gear? Broke a piece of gear? Solo parenting on the adventure and need some extra support? We got you!

NOTE: We have reserved multiple individual campsites that are next to or near each other (not a group campsite). We'll pair families with their friends who have joined or with families who have kids the same age to create our camping community. PLEASE READ OUR CAMPSITE DESCRIPTION & DISCLAIMER below.

This is our idea of SUMMER CAMP for kids, but it's for families and we get to EXPLORE DIFFERENT CAMPGROUNDS + PARKS! You will make wonderful memories with your family and friends 🏕️❤️🫂🤲🏽

🎁 Want to give this as a gift? Gift cards are available here — a great way to help a friend or family member experience this adventure.
